greet: Ehen, you don find the mortar and im pestle. The mortar na odo, and the pestle na im pikin.
greet.ask: Wetin dem dey call the mortar?
carved: One carver cut the mortar from one piece of hard wood, so e fit take plenty years of pounding.
family: My husband papa carve am the year dem born my husband. Three generations for dis family don chop from am.
rhythm: Long time ago, for evening, you go hear pounding from every compound across the village. Im rhythm dey tell everybody say house don near.
together: Two women fit pound inside one mortar, dem go dey take turn with two pestle, dem no go miss one beat. We dey sing as we dey work.
yam: We go put boiled yam inside, pound am until e smooth and soft. Na im be pounded yam.
yam.ask: Wetin una dey pound inside am?
more: We dey pound pepper, grain and leaf for pot too.
more.ask: Wetin else dem dey use am for?
sound: When you hear pestle dey fall, again and again, you know say food dey come.
